reviews.title: Good Art, Bad Optimization
reviews.text: The art in this game is amazing, definitely among my top favorites in animation. It’s also extremely f2p-friendly: I was able to easily build a decent collection of characters without having to grind excessively like in other gacha games. The gameplay itself is relatively simple, which I’m neutral on. The only issue is that the app constantly crashes. I thought it was due to my older device, which I had updated for other reasons, but it still crashes even on a newer one. I’m at a loss for words. Please fix the optimization issues! I would love to play the game, but I can’t because it crashes seconds after I log in.

reviews.title: Constant crashing on iOS
reviews.text:
I like this game. I really do. But what is going on with this game and its interactions with iOS? It CONSTANTLY crashes. Anytime you draw an outfit? Crash. Anytime you draw gear? Crash. Upgrading a costume? Crash. Collecting dailies, costume tickets, event resource, etc. Crash. Watching a gooner bait preview of a new outfit? Crash.

I have NEVER left a review on another game in the App Store, but this one needs some adjusting for iOS because it’s infuriating to play on this operating system.
